notes.title: Doc Clock: The Toasted Sandwich of Time Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Doc Clock: The Toasted Sandwich of Time have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:
  • Removed requirement for hardware vertex shaders. This allows the game to be run on a wider range of hardware including some earlier Intel graphics chipsets.
  • Improved error messages with greater level of detail.
